description: Read a custom collection owned by the signed-in user, including its keyword filters, AI filter ID, source streams, and selected custom targets. Returns the full configuration that update_collection replaces; get_collection_posts returns the posts.
name: get_collection

aiFilterId.description: Attached AI filter ID for get_ai_filter; null when none

columnWidth.description: Column width in pixels from set_collection_column_width; null when unset

all.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains every word

any.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains at least one word

phrase.description: Exact phrase; a post matches when its text contains it

all.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains every word

phrase.description: Exact phrase; a post matches when its text contains it

values.description: Rules that mark matching post text with a color

color.description: Synoptic app color for matching text: one of lightYellow, lightOrange, lightTeal, lightBlue, yellow, green, blue, red, orange, purple

id.description: ID of this item for the tools that take it

matchingSourcesOnly.description: Whether the Synoptic app source picker shows only streams with market matching

usesAllTargets.description: True when no targets are selected, so every target available to the user is included and customTargets is empty

title: Read collection
